title: [AUG-197] Implement Meeting Copilot: four modes (Off / Local / Claude explains / Always-on), LiveFeed, gate g2, hint cards and compact widgets
important_constraints:
Order: after the implementations of AUG-194 (Settings → AI assistants tab) and AUG-195 (ASSISTANT overlay, Claude child transport, resolveClaudeCli).
Depends on: the implementation tasks created from AUG-194-hinr8y and AUG-195-5dsqpc. Research: AUG-196-gxk1pv. Parent: AUG-193-bj5mw1.

Rules:
- Keep the existing live pipeline, LiveTextCorrector, LiveActionItemsExtractor and Send to Praxis unchanged in behaviour; LiveFeed is an additive tap.
- The gate and the local search always run locally. Transcript text leaves the machine only in the Claude explains or Always-on modes, which the user chose themselves.
- Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md: process.platform guards, path.join, Windows taskkill /T /F, macOS PATH via ensureToolPaths.
- UI: 0 border-radius, green = primary, yellow = attention, red = danger only.

Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.
